rounds.text: The bull case of a cheap price-to-book ratio is entirely undermined by fundamental unprofitability, evidenced by a negative return on equity of -1.1% against a sector benchmark of 5.11% [E8] and a negative return on assets of -0.79% [E7]. Operating performance is in a severe state of collapse, highlighted by trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth plunging to -119% [E13] and compounded profit growth cratering to -146% [E14]. This operational destruction naturally translates into a deep negative price-to-earnings ratio of -27.21x, which looks atrocious compared to the sector benchmark of 20.07x [E5]. Compounding these fundamental distress signals, the stock has suffered a 1-year compounded share price decline of -34% [E17] and offers a negligible dividend yield of just 0.09% [E3]. Furthermore, price growth exceeds profit growth by a staggering 112%, demonstrating that investor expectations are dangerously detached from delivery [E41]. Conceded: [E1].
